caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter that sends these follow-ups for you. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: the 3 follow-ups I send when a lead stops replying, word for word.

1. A few hours later: "hey! did you still want the details on the program?" Short, easy to answer, zero pressure.

2. A bit later: "no stress if now's not the time. What's holding you back, timing or budget?"

3. The last one: "I'll stop bugging you, promise. If you ever want help with your goal, just reply here."

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: you write your follow-ups once, he sends them through Manychat, between 1 and 23 hours after the lead's last message, and stops as soon as the lead replies or books.

The catch: follow-ups bring back leads who forgot, not leads who were never interested. Building and testing Setty are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.

Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
